lead.headline: AB81 patches both holes and flips the champ
lead.dek: Maye I touch your TDs? is done at 122.72. AB81 has 54.18, six starters left and a live projection of 129.46 after two waiver adds in three minutes.
lead.pull: AB81’s live win odds: 62.7%. After the early games, the champ was the favorite.
body: All day this brief asked what AB81 would do about two dead lineup spots. At 3:06 PM, with the late games underway, the front office answered: Makai Lemon off the wire for DeVonta Smith, Mark Andrews out the door to make room. At 3:08 PM, Isiah Pacheco released. At 3:09 PM, Darius Cooper in for Mike Evans. Two holes, two bodies, three minutes. Lemon projects for 9.64, Cooper for 7.95. Not glamorous. Just points where there were none.

Those points matter because the defending champ is finished. Maye I touch your TDs? closed its day at 122.72 with every starter final. Harold Fannin Jr. went for 23.4, Drake Maye 22.46, Bucky Irving 21.0. The flex spots went the other way: Zay Flowers 0.0, Drake London 1.8. Jacoby Brissett gave the second QB slot 4.46. And Jaylen Waddle put up 14.9 on the bench, which is the kind of number you only notice when the other side still has six guys to play.

AB81 sits at 54.18 with a remaining projection of 75.28. The live math lands at 129.46 to 122.72, and the odds flipped: 62.7% AB81, after the champ was favored following the early window. Derrick Henry 14.0, Kyren Williams 12.9, Rhamondre Stevenson 12.0 and Matthew Stafford 9.28 got AB81 this far. Everything else is still in the locker room.

Here’s the schedule that decides it. Four AB81 starters play Sunday night: Makai Lemon, Dallas Goedert, Darius Cooper and the Philadelphia Eagles D/ST. The last two, Sam Darnold and Jaxon Smith-Njigba, wait for Monday night, and Smith-Njigba carries the biggest projection left in this game at 25.26. AB81 needs the bodies it just signed to show up tonight so its stars don’t have to rescue it Monday.

The stakes are first place. AB81 came into Sunday at 6-1, and the other 6-1 team, Poochinski, is losing. Win this and AB81 is alone at the top. Lose it and the champ, 2-5 with 77.7% playoff odds, gets a lifeline. Next update after Sunday Night Football.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom posts 198.54 and waits
quick_hits.body: Every Cherry Blossom starter is final: Tee Higgins 37.5, Brock Bowers 28.2, Puka Nacua 25.0, Jaylen Warren 21.3, Jonah Coleman 20.4. deeboliciouskins has 122.8 and needs Jayden Daniels, D’Andre Swift and Jason Myers to cover a remaining projection of 40.16 just to reach 162.96. Live odds: 99% Cherry Blossom. Patrick Mahomes scored 25.44 on the deeboliciouskins bench.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski’s second loss is all but official
quick_hits.body: Poochinski has 98.7 and three starters to go, Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III and the Seattle Seahawks D/ST, all Monday night. Even on projection that’s 134.09 against the 181.84 Bad things man bad things posted before lunch. Bad things man bad things takes the win and a share of the conversation at the top.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy’s 181.48 holds up
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest finished the afternoon at 123.68 with only Stefon Diggs left, projecting to 136.23. Joe Burrow’s 42.48 is the best single score in the league today and it still won’t be close. Lamar Jackson finished at 0.0. Live odds: 100% Big Stric Energy.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom’s QB call held up
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom went with Trevor Lawrence over Bo Nix this morning. Lawrence: 19.4. Nix, on the bench: 19.28. Right call, barely, in a game it didn’t need.

quick_hits.headline: How this weekend’s adds finished
quick_hits.body: Jonah Coleman (Cherry Blossom, Saturday 9:36 PM): 20.4, final. Chris Godwin Jr. (Poochinski, 6:19 AM): 0.0, final. Hunter Henry (Santa Clara’s Finest, 6:23 AM): 6.0, final. Stefon Diggs (Santa Clara’s Finest, 6:20 AM), Makai Lemon and Darius Cooper (AB81, 3:06 PM and 3:09 PM): all still to play.
